decisions.reason: The candidate already requires moments that teach something or provide a real lesson. The source modification adds narrative completeness and standalone-understandability rules owned by the source Requirement, without necessarily changing the candidate's moment-value standard.
Requiring a complete standalone lesson or story does not change the permitted source collection, topic constraint, source exclusions, or one-video batch constraint.

Narrative completeness and standalone understandability do not change the independent clean-editing or prohibited-effects rules. The same message's visual-editing clause is already represented separately in this candidate's history.
The narrative-completeness modification does not change the required caption font. The same message's separate font instruction is already represented by the candidate's MODIFY.

Narrative completeness does not change the assigned count or batch-delivery obligation. The source message's separate instruction to redo all eight clips is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The complete-story and standalone-understandability rules do not alter caption color or text-effect requirements. Those separate same-message changes are already represented in the candidate history.
A clip must remain narratively complete within the existing duration range, but the source decision does not change the 20-to-120-second limits.
Requiring a complete standalone lesson or story does not change the independent requirement to select moments with good hooks.
The narrative-quality modification does not change the target of 180 approved clips per month or its counting basis.
